reason: A command-line regression testing plugin that runs a command across multiple rounds and summarizes timing or success-rate statistics using median and distribution data.

summaries.zh: 这是一个通过多轮执行命令并统计中位数、耗时范围或成功率来辅助回归测试的命令行插件。
summaries.en: A command-line plugin for regression testing that runs commands repeatedly and summarizes median timing, ranges, distributions, or success rates.

capabilities: records timing or success outcomes across multiple rounds
computes median, minimum, maximum, and distribution statistics
continues collecting results when an individual round fails
